title: Get help from Libriant
subtitle: Need someone from our team to take a look at your library? Give us temporary, one-time access.
grant.intro: If you click the button below, we'll create a one-time code. Send it to Libriant support (over the phone or email) and our team will be able to see and fix things in your library for the next 4 hours. You can end our access whenever you want.
grant.cta: Allow Libriant support to help us
grant.codeShownOnce: This code is shown only once. Copy it now and send it to Libriant support.
activeSession.title: Libriant support has access right now
log.title: What Libriant did in your library
notifications.generated: A support access code was created in your library.
notifications.redeemed: A Libriant team member just entered your library to help.
notifications.ended: Libriant's support access to your library has ended.
access.activeBanner: {admin} ({email}) opened this support session at {start}. It ends automatically at {end}.
access.endAnytime: You can end this access at any time — Libriant will lose their session immediately.
access.pendingInfo: A code starting with {prefix} is waiting to be used. It expires at {time}.
access.pendingHint: If you didn't share it yet — or you don't recognise it — revoke it. You can generate a new one anytime.
access.revokeBody: The unused code starting with {prefix} will stop working immediately. Nobody will be able to redeem it.
access.endBody: Libriant support will lose access to your library immediately. You can grant access again later if you need help.
access.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select + copy by hand.
access.help.title: How support access works
access.help.intro: Libriant staff cannot see your library's data by default. To help you with something specific, we need a one-time code you generate here.
access.help.what1: Lasts 1 hour from generation, and is usable exactly once.
access.help.what2: When a Libriant engineer redeems it with their two-factor app, it opens a 4-hour session where they can see and change your data.
access.help.what3: Every action they take is logged below — you can read it live, or after the fact.
access.help.offBody: You can end the support session immediately with “End support access” — the engineer's next click will be blocked. You can also revoke a pending code before it's used.
access.help.wontTitle: What we will not do during a session
access.help.wontBody: Change your billing plan or delete your library — those still require you to act from your own account.
